decisions.reason: Grounds diagnosis in index.js:2 inject=["apiProxy"] and index.js:9 ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers(), plus the @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency in package.json; maps to DSH-0.1.2-A1-01, explains llm.providers → listProviders and that the removed apiproxy dependency must be dropped — not just a card name.

Each of the six other categories has a No verdict with scanned-file pattern evidence; session-notes.js correctly identified as pure string/array utility; cordis.patch.yml correctly classified as composition insert, not a host-source patch, without denying the file's existence or misclassifying it.

Explicitly argues zero hits ≠ compatible (pattern-based scan limits, dependency/config/runtime evidence needed separately) and contrasts the single decisive #3 apiProxy break with the six clean categories, noting the plugin would not even activate.

Specifies post-migration build/typecheck against the target cohort, isolated cold boot with no pending service (verify-runtime.mjs), and an actual providers call asserted to succeed and return data; explicitly states these are recorded, not executed in the static fixture.
